The UEFA Europa League clash between Nottingham Forest and Fenerbahçe promises to be a thrilling contest as both teams vie for a crucial result in the knockout stages of the tournament. Nottingham Forest will look to impress on home soil, while Fenerbahçe aims to carry their strong away form into this important European encounter. With both teams showcasing their quality in recent weeks, fans are set for an exciting matchup at the City Ground.

Kick-off: 26.02.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadium: City Ground, Nottingham
Competition: UEFA Europa League

Match Preview

Nottingham Forest enters this fixture on a high, having climbed the ranks in the EFL Championship following a string of impressive performances. Under the guidance of their manager, they have showcased a solid blend of defensive resilience and attacking flair, making them a formidable opponent at home. However, they will need to maintain their focus and discipline when facing a skilled Fenerbahçe side.

On the other side, Fenerbahçe comes into the match bolstered by a strong performance in the Süper Lig, and they are known for their attacking prowess. Their manager, with deep tactical knowledge, has guided the team to become one of the top contenders in Turkey, and they aim to extend that success in Europe. Both teams are keenly aware of the stakes, making for a match loaded with intensity and potential drama.

Team Form and Analysis

Nottingham Forest

Nottingham Forest's defense has been tightened significantly as they employ a strategy focused on counter-attacking football. Recent injuries have started to clear up, with key players returning to fitness, which could enhance their chances against Fenerbahçe. With their forward line starting to find form, they are expected to pose a serious threat, particularly on the flanks where their pace can exploit the opposing defense.

Fenerbahçe

Fenerbahçe has been in fine form, showcasing an attacking style that emphasizes quick transitions and creative playmaking from midfield. Their injury list has been managed well, with crucial players available to lead the charge in front of goal. Expected to dominate possession, they might adopt a pressing game to unsettle Nottingham Forest's backline while aiming to capitalize on defensive errors.
